title: Register cloudflare-sandbox as an honoured executor, and decide where collect, cancel and dispose live
description:
Triaged 2026-09-23 from xte's close-out, which held on untriaged findings; the finding keys it absorbs are in this tick's notes. xte was merged as building blocks (operator's choice B) and its unmet goal moved here, because it is the same single cloud path yoh reconciles.

keh built internal/exec/cloudflaresandbox, but the CLI's honoured executor set does not include it, so no run can select it: the per-tick sandbox executor exists and is unusable (5471176f, high). keh also left open which of the four operations (dispatch, inspect, collect, cancel) cross the Worker door and which the Go side does from git (a35ff202), and wiring it into the honoured set waits on that decision (a69a9747). Decide it, record the decision where the executor's doc says the contract lives (sandbox-dispatch.ts is the ONE place the HTTP contract lives), and register the executor.
acceptance_criteria: run-epic accepts executor cloudflare-sandbox; the placement of collect, cancel and dispose is decided and recorded beside the door's contract; each operation is implemented or explicitly refused with a reason; and the full Go and TypeScript suites pass
